Sagrada Esperança|Sag Esp]] 6–1 [[Atlético Petróleos do Namibe|Atl Nam]] (23 Sep 2007)}} | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | matches = 182 | total goals = 372 | prevseason = [[2006 Girabola|2006]] | nextseason = [[2008 Girabola|2008]] }} The '''2007 [[Girabola]]''' was the 29th season of the top-tier football league in [[Angola]]. The season ran from 14 February to 21 October 2007. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2008 [[Gira Angola]].{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/ango2011.html |title=Angola 2011 |date=May 6, 2011 |access-date=May 20, 2011 |author=King, Ian}} [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro Atlético de Luanda]] were crowned champions, while [[Académica Petróleo Kwanda Soyo|Académica do Soyo]], [[Atlético Petróleos do Namibe|Atlético do Namibe]] and [[Juventude do Moxico]] were relegated.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2007/9/42/Football-Interclube-Wins-National-Senior-Championship,d2bb8045-88a8-4c00-b5bf-06521245c579.html |title=Football: Interclube Wins National Senior Championship |publisher=ANGOP.com |date= 21 Oct 2007 |access-date= 8 Sep 2015}} [[Manucho|Manucho Gonçalves]] of [[Atlético Petróleos Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] finished as the top scorer with 14 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2007/9/43/Football-Petro-Manucho-Best-Scorer-First-Division-Championship,9682959c-bf08-4c55-86d9-034682bc2f84.html |title=Football: Petro's Manucho Best Scorer Of First Division Championship |publisher=ANGOP.com |date=22 Oct 2007 |access-date=8 Sep 2015 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304103801/http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2007/9/43/Football-Petro-Manucho-Best-Scorer-First-Division-Championship,9682959c-bf08-4c55-86d9-034682bc2f84.html |url-status=dead }} ==Changes from the 2006 season== '''Relegated:''' [[F.C.
